player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ပိူင်ၽၢင်ဢၼ်ဢမ်ႇထုၵ်ႇမႅၼ်ႈၼၼ်ႉ၊ ၶႅၼ်းတေႃႈတၢင်ႇပၼ် လွင်ႈလၢမ်းၶၢတ်ႈၶွင်ၸဝ်ႈၵဝ်ႇ မိူၼ်ၼင်ႇ [<number>]။
invalid_move.out_of_range: ၼႃႉတီႈဢမ်ႇပေႃးလႆႈ တေလႆႈပဵၼ်တီႈၼႂ်း {min_guess} လႄႈ {max_guess}။

message.round_guesses: ၽူႈလႄႇ 0 ယွင်ႈ {guess0}၊ ၽူႈလႄႇ 1 ယွင်ႈ {guess1}။ ၸိူင်ႉၼၼ် တီႈတႃႇၵတ်ႉၶႅၼ်ႇၼႆႉပဵၼ် {target}။
message.round_draw: လွၵ်းၸုမ်ႈၼႆႉ ပဵၼ်လွင်ႈၽဵင်ႇပဵင်းၵၼ်ယဝ်ႉ။
message.round_win: ၽူႈလဵၼ်ႈ {winner} လႆႈဢွင်ႇပေႉတီႈလွႆးဝႃး!

outcome.draw: လွင်ႈလဵၼ်ႈဢၼ်ပဵၼ်လွင်ႈၽဵင်ႇပဵင်းၼၼ်ႉ ပဵၼ်ဝႆႉၼင်ႇၼႆယဝ်ႉ။
